ImageDescription.value: John Shuck stars as Gregory "Yoyo" Yoyonovich, a robot which has been programmed to be the ultimate unflappable and indestructible police detective in "Holmes and Yoyo," new ABC Television Network comedy series to premiere in the fall SATURDAYS (8:00-8:30 p.m., EDT). Yoyo, named for the scientist who created him, is teamed with veteran Detective Alexander Holmes (Richard B. Shull) by officials who want to test Yoyo's capabilities and don't bother to tell Holmes about the experiment.
